rules.label: bright, clear weather
rules.narrative: Sunlit conditions favor crisp citrus, lifted herbs, and clean sparkling finishes.

rules.label: soft, overcast weather
rules.narrative: Cloud cover pairs beautifully with balanced fruit, gentle botanicals, and rounded texture.

rules.label: rainy weather
rules.narrative: Rain calls for deeper fruit, warming spice, and a little aromatic drama.

rules.label: snowy weather
rules.narrative: Snowy air rewards warming spice, creamy texture, and slow-sipping depth.

rules.label: stormy weather
rules.narrative: Electric skies stand up to bold spirits, ginger heat, smoke, and vivid acidity.

rules.label: hot weather
rules.narrative: High temperatures need long, cooling drinks with citrus, mint, and plenty of lift.

rules.label: cold weather
rules.narrative: Cold air invites amber spirits, baking spice, roasted notes, and richer texture.

rules.label: mild weather
rules.narrative: Mild conditions leave room for balanced flavor, fresh aromatics, and an easy finish.
